name: Tea Tree Oil + Geothermal Water + Vitamin E
indication_description:
This gel is indicated in-
  • Deeply clean acne-prone skin
  • Excessive sebum control
  • Acne Vulgaris
  • Dark Spot
dosage_description: Twice a day in the morning and evening.
contraindications_description: Contraindicated in any other ingredient of this preparations.
storage_conditions_description: Keep below 30°C temperature, away from light & moisture. Keep out of the reach of children.
